name: WHA-Console
description: Super simple console management system for managing multiple whatsrook sessions.

JWT_SECRET.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens.

REDIS_ADDR.description: Address of Redis instance (optional depending on setup).

WEBAUTHN_RP_ID.description: Relying Party ID for WebAuthn/Passkeys (domain name without protocol/port).

WEBAUTHN_RP_DISPLAY_NAME.description: Relying Party display name for WebAuthn prompts.

WEBAUTHN_RP_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origin URLs for WebAuthn authentication.
